motivation: Gate B.0 adds deterministic experimental DSH Launcher runtime workspace identity binding and one-app multi-workspace acceptance, with protected verifier tests updated to cover the new evidence contract.
invariants: Production Kernel, ABI, workspace scope, approval authority, production trusted runtime, and dependencies remain unchanged. The experimental Launcher only supplements the existing user-selected security-scoped workspace, Kernel scope checks, approval digest, device/inode validation, marker integrity, and result identity validation. DSH receives no directory authority.
authority_delta: 0 production Kernel authority, 0 Kernel ABI, 0 production workspace-scope authority, 0 production trusted-runtime delta, 0 production dependencies, 0 new production processes or IPC operations. The disposable signed test-app Launcher overlay gains runtime trial-to-workspace consistency checks and fails closed on identity mismatch.
real_os_tests: A no-model app built with the repository signing path passed deep/strict signature verification and exact-source prebuilt validation. Focused tests passed (8 builder, 14 runner; pinned DSH 19 semantic and 17 bridge/lifecycle). The first signed Trial A attempt selected a disposable workspace and approved one scoped read; Kernel/Runner returned successfully with no workspace mutation, but the Host rejected result delivery as invalid_request. Source tracing found runtime_trial_id in the generated Launcher trace was omitted from the experimental strict allowlist. The allowlist and regression test are corrected; corrected-source signed trials, final canonical suite and final Security Freeze runs are still pending.
trusted_delta: Production trusted source delta is 0. The disposable signed DSH app's experimental Trusted Launcher overlay now binds a fresh runtime trial to the actual Picker bookmark, rechecks workspace and marker identity around approval and Kernel result handling, and includes the runtime trial ID in its bounded result trace. The experimental protocol allowlist validates this ID instead of rejecting the generated field. The overlay is not installed into the production app. The failed first signed attempt and the corrected source-level tests are disclosed; independent security review and corrected signed acceptance remain required.
baseline_decision: Update only the protected DSH acceptance-test hashes and the aggregate manifest digest. Record exact PR #47 base e27aed3ee3f40e7a008517ab7d8242bebe25a7c2. Independent Security review of the experimental Launcher delta remains pending; this declaration and passing tests are not approval.
